plan.notes: Source: official CECS department sample flowchart 'COMPUTER SCIENCE UNOFFICIAL FLOWCHART AY 2025-2026' (Rev. BMS 2/5/2026), published on www.csulb.edu: https://www.csulb.edu/sites/default/files/2026/documents/2025-2026%20Computer%20Science-BMS-02.05.2026.pdf . Cross-validated against the official CSULB catalog program page 'Program: Computer Science, B.S.' (2025-2026 Undergraduate and Graduate Catalog): http://catalog.csulb.edu/preview_program.php?catoid=11&poid=5764 . Catalog year 2025-2026 is the actual year of the source flowchart and catalog. Transcription method: term-by-term grid transcribed from the department flowchart PDF (8 semester columns); course titles/units/prereqs cross-checked with the catalog program requirements. The flowchart sheet labels itself 'UNOFFICIAL and subject to change' but it is the department's officially published recommended 4-year order for this exact program; no other official term-by-term sequence exists. Caveats: (1) The flowchart's per-semester unit headers (14 / 15 / 16-17 / 16 / 15 / 15 / 15 / 12-15) are approximate; the transcribed semesters sum to 15/14/17/15/15/15/15/15 = 121 units total, within the sheet's stated 118-122 range and above the catalog 120-unit minimum. (2) PHYS 151 (4u) is used for the science slot; CHEM 111A (5u) is the listed alternative (would make 122). (3) GE category slots (1C/A1, 1A/A2, 3A/C1, 3B/C2, 6/F, UD-D) and POSC 100 are student-choice within their GE areas; semester placement follows the flowchart grid. (4) Track electives: 12 units from ONE of three tracks (Software Development / Cybersecurity / Machine Learning-AI); the flowchart requires CECS 323 for Track 1, CECS 478 for Track 2, CECS 456 for Track 3 (CECS 427 noted as an option); track and CS electives cannot double-count. (5) CECS 282 (Advanced C++) appears in older catalog editions but is NOT in the AY 2025-2026 flowchart sequence. (6) Double-counts per the department GE worksheet: MATH 122 = GE 2/B4, PHYS 151/CHEM 111A = GE 5A/B1+5C/B3, BIOL = GE 5B/B2, ENGR 350 = UD-C, CECS 491A = UD-B, ENGR 361/390 = GWAR/WI. (7) Legend: to fully declare in COE complete MATH 122, MATH 123, CECS 174, PHYS 151 or CHEM 111A, and GE 1A & 1C with >= 2.5 GPA before 60 units; maintain >= 2.0 GPA after declaration. ENGR 350 requires 60+ units; ENGR 361/390 requires GE Foundations and 60+ units.
